tasks.short: Lead public forestry workshops and develop educational materials

steps.what: Develop accurate forestry and conservation educational content for the intended public
Arrange existing text, illustrations and references into the workshop handout
Check the complete handout for accuracy, accessibility and practical instructions
Lead the public workshop and respond to participants' forestry questions

tasks.design: Configure the existing handout styles and reference fields in {DOCS} before adding code. Reuse layout for teacher-authored forestry content, retaining source verification, full material checks and the actual public workshop.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated layout work competes with developing and teaching accurate content.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document templates can arrange known text, image anchors and reference fields.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining uncertain conservation advice in terms the public can use.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt explanations to participants and correct dangerous misunderstandings.
tasks.altitude: More attention to educational content with unchanged teaching responsibility.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: document styles and reusable layouts can arrange supplied teaching content without generating scientific advice.

assumptions: Provisional boundary includes actual existing handout preparation and workshop delivery. No new attendance or workshop-progress record is introduced.

The teacher supplies checked text, existing licensed illustrations, captions and reference metadata in s1. The template removes only the 10 layout points; original diagrams, missing sources and repair remain s1/s3. Excess repair lowers the estimate.

Test native document styles first. Ordinary author saves remain within s3 without gates or credit. A real separate public upload, printing job or email distribution is not assumed and must be separately counted if present.
unknowns: Existing template availability and actual layout share
research_questions: Reformat a real forestry handout and count corrections and missing illustration work.

incremental.description: Maintain handout styles and accessibility checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 10 layout points less 1 upkeep. A new field-identification workshop needs bespoke illustrations and arrangement; reuse only 2 points of headings and reference layout, retaining the rest: 2 minus 1 = 1.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Perform departmental administrative review of forestry staffing, rooms and fieldwork requirements
Resolve departmental staffing priorities and teaching-resource trade-offs
Compare decided course allocations against explicit time and room constraints
Write the actual departmental teaching allocation plan

loop.purpose: Restate the head's specified allocations in the existing plan
loop.input: Decided allocations and explicit conflict dispositions
loop.check: Head verifies teaching responsibilities, exclusions, unresolved conflicts and every stated commitment against decisions
loop.stop: Missing decision or two failed drafts returns writing to the head
loop.why_not_simpler: Native tables and fixed fields come first; variable explanation of decided arrangements needs bounded prose drafting

steps.what: Check the complete final allocation plan and its staff distribution list
Send the final departmental allocation plan to the approved staff recipients

tasks.design: For the teaching-allocation part of department administration, test native {CALENDAR} conflict checks against {LMS} course requirements. A bounded draft in {DOCS} restates decisions already made by the head; final review precedes the separately retained staff send in {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Course planning mixes explicit clashes with judgement about staffing and field teaching.
tasks.enabler_now: Native clash checks can remove repeated comparisons; limited drafting can restate decided arrangements.
tasks.still_hard: Negotiating workloads and resolving unsuitable or incomplete allocations.
tasks.human_edge: Accept responsibility for departmental priorities and staff commitments.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated clash checking, with unchanged department authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: calendar constraint checks detect explicit time conflicts; human department heads still decide staffing and teaching priorities.

assumptions: This provisional boundary is the existing teaching-allocation workflow, not every department-head duty. Other administration needs its own measured composition; no savings are extrapolated to budgets or personnel decisions.

The head verifies course ID, staff ID, start/end, room, capacity and fieldwork exceptions in s1. Existing scheduling owners supply calendars; missing or incompatible fields are repaired manually within s1/s5 and unsupported cases stay manual.

The 10 comparison points are repeated manual checks replaced by native clash rules; runtime already automatic earns no credit. s4 retains 12 points for input, substantive writing, corrections and ordinary save; only 3 restatement points are removed.

The plan already allocates teaching and is used by department staff. It is not a new meeting record. s5 binds the final plan and recipients before the separate actual send, which retains its full small time. Ordinary author saves are ungated.
unknowns: Share of departmental work actually spent on this workflow
research_questions: Observe a real forestry teaching allocation and compare native clash checks with manual corrections.

incremental.description: Maintain explicit scheduling constraints and draft instructions

approvals.approved_version: s5 exact final allocation plan and staff recipients; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 10 comparison and 3 restatement points less 1 upkeep. New field-course arrangements leave only 2 points of ordinary room clashes and 0.8 routine plan wording reusable: 2 plus 0.8 minus 1 = 1.8.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Participate in campus and community events

steps.what: Read the actual campus or community event programme and participation instructions
Participate personally in the campus or community event

tasks.design: Keep personal participation and separately counted programme reading with the teacher. Existing event documents in {DOCS} already provide the context; no established preparation, record or send operation is removed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Participation depends on the teacher's actual presence and interaction.
tasks.enabler_now: Native event information provides access without a new automation opportunity in this boundary.
tasks.still_hard: Representing the department and responding constructively to participants.
tasks.human_edge: Build relationships through informed personal participation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: participation in campus and community events primarily involves personal interaction; it does not inherently require a participant-owned activity report.

assumptions: Provisional boundary is attending and participating, not organizing an event or developing a workshop. Event organizers supply the programme; actual reading remains counted.

Before zero, check programme lookup, registration, preparation and written/send obligations. This encounter already has direct programme access and no established registration or reporting duty. Add any actual booking, presentation preparation or report before estimating that different workflow.
No new trailing event record or capture is introduced. Native document access is assessed first; no ongoing implementation is proposed.
unknowns: Any actual booking or written output included in participation
research_questions: Observe event participation and identify actual preparation, registration or follow-up work.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Retain all 10 programme-reading and 90 participation points. An unfamiliar community event requires full contextual reading, and no real duplicate record or send has been established to remove.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide professional forestry consulting to government or industry

steps.what: Verify the client's forestry question, site information and source evidence
Provide professional consulting advice to government or industry on forestry questions
Write the commissioned forestry advice brief

loop.purpose: Restate the consultant's specified advice in the commissioned brief
loop.input: Verified site facts, sources and consultant-authored recommendations
loop.output: Draft brief with linked factual statements
loop.check: Consultant checks ecological meaning, omissions, uncertainty and whether every recommendation is their own
loop.stop: Missing evidence, invented advice or two failed drafts returns writing to manual
loop.why_not_simpler: Native brief sections and references come first; variable advice prose needs bounded drafting rather than fixed fields

steps.what: Check the complete final advice brief and exact client recipients
Send the approved forestry advice brief to the specified client recipients

tasks.design: Use the existing brief template in {DOCS} first, then a bounded draft of the consultant's own verified forestry advice. Keep ecological analysis and client discussion human, check the final brief and recipients, and retain the separate actual send in {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: A commissioned brief requires restating verified facts and advice coherently.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-linked drafting can assist that restatement without choosing recommendations.
tasks.still_hard: Making defensible site-specific recommendations under incomplete ecological evidence.
tasks.human_edge: Own professional advice and communicate uncertainty to the client.
tasks.altitude: Less routine report restatement with unchanged consulting accountability.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded drafting can restate supplied consulting advice, while site-specific forestry recommendations require professional judgement.

assumptions: Provisional boundary is an engagement already requiring a client advice brief. Oral-only consulting has no new report requirement and must be reweighted without the brief benefit.

The teacher verifies site ID, dates, source versions, observations and recommendations in s1-s2. These are not free validated facts. s3 retains input, specialist writing, corrections and ordinary save; 4 routine restatement points are removed from 20.

Native brief templates are tested first. s4 approves the exact final advice and recipients only for the actual client send. s5 retains its full small time. Ordinary author saves need no gate or saving.
unknowns: Actual written deliverable and restatement effort
research_questions: Compare a real forestry brief with its source material and count drafting corrections.

incremental.description: Maintain drafting instructions and source-link checks

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact final advice brief and client recipients; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 4 restatement points less 1 upkeep. For unfamiliar site ecology, retain bespoke specialist writing and remove only 1.5 points of factual restatement: 1.5 minus 1 = 0.5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain public teaching, departmental decisions and consulting accountability while reducing verified layout and comparison work.
role.ambitious_version: No additional service is justified by these provisional estimates.
